items.description: Ensure no ingress firewall rule allows SSH (22) or RDP (3389) from the public Internet.
items.recommended_value: Restrict SSH/RDP to IAP (Identity-Aware Proxy) CIDR: 35.235.240.0/20
items.remediation_notes: Delete 'allow-all-ssh' rule and mandate Cloud IAP TCP forwarding for remote administration.

items.control_name: Cloud Armor OWASP Top 10 Protection on Global Load Balancers
items.description: External HTTPS load balancers must have Cloud Armor policies attached with OWASP rulesets.
items.current_value: Policy 'prod-edge-armor' attached with OWASP SQLi/XSS prevention enabled
items.recommended_value: Cloud Armor policy attached to all public backend services
items.remediation_notes: Continue monitoring Cloud Armor rate limiting and bot management telemetry.

items.control_name: Enforce TLS 1.2+ minimum on SSL Policies
items.description: Load balancers must use SSL policies that prohibit TLS 1.0/1.1 and insecure ciphers.
items.recommended_value: Min TLS 1.2, MODERN or RESTRICTED cipher profile
items.remediation_notes: Regularly audit SSL certificate expiry and ensure managed HTTPS certificates are used.

items.control_name: Enable Private Google Access on VPC Subnets
items.description: Subnets without external IPs must have Private Google Access enabled to reach GCP APIs securely.
items.remediation_notes: Enable Private Google Access on 'subnet-dev-us-east1' and 'subnet-qa-eu-west1'.
